text:
Nia: Quick kudos to Carlos and Jin for jumping on the pricing table bug during the partner walkthrough 10 minutes turnaround — you two turned panic into applause. :clap:
Carlos: thanks! Rae spotted the bad CSV import and Jin patched the formatter in 10 mins.
Jin: team effort  Ollie ran the hotfix deploy and rolled it forward.
help-bot: note: ad-hoc-pricing-fix completed by Ollie; no downtime recorded. :white_check_mark:
Rae: extra shoutout to Design (Mira) for editing the slide so the demo kept momentum. Saved the flow.
Ollie: small thank-you plan  I'll stock the kitchen with mini cookies tomorrow. Thinking a "cookie coin" jar — drop a coin for a mini cookie. :cookie:
Nia: poll time: react with :card_index: for handwritten thank-you notes or :confetti_ball: for kudos-tokens (stickers/coins).
Rae: :confetti_ball: tokens. low-friction and showy. can we have a token that says "Demo Rescuer"?
Carlos: I'll design 50 tokens: "Demo Rescuer", "Docs Hero", "Design Saver". Ollie, can you print them?
Ollie: yep, printing at 2pm. volunteers to stick them on the Kudos Wall after standup? 2 minutes.
Jin: happy to stick them up.
Mira: love the idea. also adding a tiny sticker that says "Saved by Design" for the design team.
Nia: logistics note: write initials/date on the back of tokens when you give them. and adding a 1-line to Friday digest: "micro-win: Carlos/Jin fixed pricing CSV during partner walkthrough".
Rae: GIF for digest: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-team-1BkQ0g
Nia: thanks all  small rituals = big morale. :trophy:
